description: Official registers of tokenized assets and digital-asset firms for any of 250 jurisdictions (ISO 3166 + EU): which authority supervises, which public registers exist, which we read, and the entries themselves. Use it for "what is registered in Lithuania", "is firm X licensed anywhere" (pass `query` without `country`), or "which countries publish a list of token issues" (kind=issuance). A register entry records a licence, registration or approval by an authority — it is NOT proof that a token was issued, and it says nothing about who may buy. Provider registers list companies, not instruments: never add their entries to a count of tokens.

country.description: ISO code (DE, HK), English name or slug (germany, hong-kong). Omit to search every register.

kind.description: issuance = individual issues; issuer = registered issuers; provider = licensed firms; sandbox = sandbox participants; event = decisions/letters; candidate = full-text search hits, unconfirmed

offset.description: Skip this many entries (use nextOffset from the previous answer)

query.description: Free-text match on entry name, issuer, ISIN or register number

name: get_country_registers

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent when there is no more
